title: Underarm 1981: aakhri gend zameen par lurhka di 😮 #shorts
facebook_title: Underarm 1981: the last ball rolled along the ground
caption:
Aakhri gend, tie ke liye chahiye tha chhakka… aur bowler ne gend zameen par lurhka di! 😮

1 February 1981, Melbourne: captain Greg Chappell ne apne chhote bhai Trevor se underarm gend dalwayi. Australia 6 run se jeeta. Us waqt yeh rule ke andar tha, par khel ki spirit ke khilaaf — aur ICC ne underarm par pabandi laga di.

Aap captain hote to kya karte? Comment mein bataiye! 👇
